name: Sanguine Rupture
caption:
A terrifying aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster with bloodthorns to cover the area with tainted blood, inflicting hemorrhage buildup and fire damage. Charging extends the surge of the blood.

Sorcerers who pledged themselves to the Blood Star would indulge in physical depletion, so much so that their very flesh molded to the staves they used.
 Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Oracle Bubbles
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Produces several small magical bubbles that drift towards foes before they naturally pop.
Charging increases the delay before the bubbles pop.

The claymen search for lost oracles within their bubbles. Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Great Oracular Bubble
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Produces a gigantic magical bubble that drifts towards foes before it naturally ruptures.
Charging increases the delay before the bubble pops.

The claymen search for lost oracles within their bubbles. Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Crystal Dart
caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Fires a swift crystal shard in front of the caster.

A sorcery created by the Crystalians that predates almost all of Caria, yet its influence can be seen in numerous magical Carian arts and phalanxes. Boosted by: Crystalian Sorcery

name: Ancestral Wisps
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestral spirits.

Set staff alight with ancestral magic and scatter particles of spirit energy that make foes more susceptible to magic damage.

The horns of the ancestral spirits grew to unyielding lengths, entangling the bodies of their worshippers and sharing their power. Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Rampart Gale
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Manipulate the surrounding winds and hurl them at foes. This sorcery can be charged, cast repeatedly and while in motion.

The mighty force of Stormveil's winds were long uncontested.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: River of Knives
caption:
Superior ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Summon a storm of ice spikes that seek foes for a short time, inflicting frostbite.
Charging enhances potency and duration.

Desperate against the giantsflame, Zamor sorcerers waited in ambush and hurled bolts of frigid magic at unwary opponents.
 Boosted by: Cold Sorcery

name: Pursuing Rancor
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Summons a ghostflame rancor that manifests near foes and explodes after a brief delay.

Deathbirds acted as fire keepers of the spirit realm graveyard, but this particular fire burned a blackened white and gleamed cold like snow.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Ancestral Clarity
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestral spirits.

Alleviates any sleep and madness buildup within the caster.

Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Runic Thirst
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Imbues the caster's body with an enriching ghostflame aura, sapping more runes from slain enemies for a short time.

The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Crystal Lance
caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Conjures a magic crystal spike to impale foes.
Cast again to propel the lance forward as a projectile, exploding on impact.

A sorcery created by the Crystalians that predates almost all of Caria, yet its influence can be seen in numerous magical Carian arts and phalanxes.
 Boosted by: Crystalian Sorcery

name: Returned Once More
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancient ancestral spirits.

Bathe staff in spectral energy, imbuing caster with an empowering prayer that saves them from otherwise fatal damage.
Temporarily boosts non-physical attack after the effect.

Death, as enforced by the Erdtree's grace, is necessary. But those privileged by the sight of budding horns could stall an otherwise inevitable fate.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Billowing Rancor
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Bathe the staff with the biting cold of ghostflame and thrust forward, calling a fan of ghostflame pillars in front of the caster.

Deathbirds acted as fire keepers of the spirit realm graveyard, but this particular fire burned a blackened white and gleamed cold like snow.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Spectral Pillars of Light
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestral spirits.

Charge staff with ancestral energy, then plunge staff into the ground to cast an array of spectral arrows that pierce the caster's surroundings.

Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Blasphemous Misdirection
caption:
One of the terrible sorceries of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Violently set the staff aflame, then deliver a sweeping blow that sends forth a seething bladed spirit.
When charged, the spirit pierces through foes while siphoning their health.

Rykard's eventual turn to heresy preceded his amounting to nothing greater than the gods he stood against.
 Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Simmering Bolides
caption:
One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

Swing staff upwards, summoning a line of volcanic eruptions that travel forward.

Rykard's restoring of the ancient hexes led to the discovery that the magma was so ubiquitous on Mt. Gelmir, it could be pulled from underneath the very soil. Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Primordial Arc
caption:
Primeval sorcery devised by Lusat.

Cast a powerful horizontal arc of starry torrents that spreads outward.

Lusat saw echoes of knowledge, kingdoms, and cultures reverberate through an incomprehensible infinity. Every possible outcome at once, and then just as abruptly, nothing at all. Boosted by: Lustat Sorcery

name: Biting Winds
caption:
Ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Steady the staff and channel an icy storm around the caster's body to inflict frostbite buildup.

Zamor knights were masters of obscurity. When they approached, the bite of cold inevitably followed.
 Boosted by: Cold Sorcery

name: Nebular Strike
caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Showers armament held in the right hand with gravity magic, dealing extra magic and poise damage for a short time.

Dark clouds of dense, enormous stars are indicative of the Naturalborn’s power, or perhaps something greater…
 Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Stalwart Bubble
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Increases poise and hardness for the caster.

Some of the ancient priests preferred a polearm while others supported them from afar using largely defensive sorceries. Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Frostgale Lance
caption:
Ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Leap forward through biting winds and thrust the staff downward to create a massive freezing tornado at the point of impact.

The knights of Zamor channeled icy winds through their weapons, as their powerful sorceries doubled as marvelous displays of swordsmanship.
 Boosted by: Cold Sorcery

name: Night Maiden's Mirage
caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Quickly retreat backwards, concealing the caster's presence while releasing a damaging silver mist.

Night Maidens would often employ Sellian sorceries to quickly disengage from danger. Capable assassins, however, saw them fit for exploiting weakness.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Eochaid's Incisions
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster to conjure an aberrant blade and attack in a wide sweep, inflicting a unique type of hemorrhage that wears down the health of foes for a brief time.
Can cast another follow-up attack.

Aberrant sorcerers were not well-versed in traditional magic. Their discovery of the Blood Star yielded sorceries that could instead be cast by inflicting wounds upon oneself.
 Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Ancient Priest's Blessing
caption:
Ancient sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Accumulates magical blessings of ancient priests, sacrificing the caster's attack power to vastly boost all damage negation for allies.

The ancient dynasty battled as a single unit with synergy that rivaled a hivemind.
 Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Crystal Mace
caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Conjures a magic crystal mace to smash foes.
Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up casts.

A sorcery created by the Crystalians that predates almost all of Caria, yet its influence can be seen in numerous magical Carian arts and phalanxes.

name: Zamor Tempest
caption:
Superior ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Build frost magic within one's body and unleash it as a mighty gale.
Charging enhances potency.

Centuries of war battered the top of the mountain. Even when Zamor blood permeated the very snow, they persisted still.
 Boosted by: Cold Sorcery

name: Lamplight
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Creates a beacon of spiritual lamplight from the Helphen, illuminating surroundings while boosting magic damage negation and frostbite resistance.

The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, and it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Night of Nascent Frost
caption:
Superior ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Creates a magical ice vortex around the caster. For a short while, dealing physical damage will either heal or boost magic attack depending on the caster's current HP.

The night of frost emptied all life from the mountain's glow. The crops withered and the leaves fell, never to grow again.

name: Preserving Bubble
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Calls upon the nurturing of the ancient priests, ejecting any and all filth from the caster's body.

Hidden within the warrens and ruins of their own home, the ancient shamans wait eternally for augurs of wisdom that have long expired. Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Regnerative Bubble
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Restores a small amount of health (480) over a short time for the caster.

The priests of the ancient dynasty uniquely commanded magic to support others in their rank, as most of them were well-practiced in healing sorceries. Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Superior Regenerative Bubble
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Restores a moderate amount of health (880) over a short time for the caster.

The priests of the ancient dynasty uniquely commanded magic to support others in their rank, as most of them were well-practiced in healing sorceries.
 Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Recusant's Vow
caption:
Sorcery developed from the blasphemy of Rykard's followers.

Creates a magmatic shield that boosts fire damage and fire damage negation.
Casting again will fling pools of magma widely in front of the caster.

Rykard's followers once thought his pursuit to be a righteous path, even throwing themselves to the maw of the Serpent King during their audience.
 Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Ancient Tidal Curtain
caption:
Ancient sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Restores a moderate amount of health (880) over a short time and lowers all status resistances of enemies in the caster's vicinity.

Hidden within the warrens and ruins of their own home, the ancient shamans wait eternally for augurs of wisdom that have long expired.
 Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Needle Volley
caption:
Ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Fires a wide-fanning volley of ice shards that shred foes.
Charging extends the duration of the volley.

Cloaked in icy tempests, the knights of Zamor have challenged the Fire Giants since ancient times.

name: Soul Barter
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestral spirits.

Set caster alight with spectral energy and convert any damage received into FP.

Spectral phenomena once coexisted with the Erdtree, mirroring the flora and fauna of daily life.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Spirit Stifle
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestral spirits.

Raise staff aloft and summon a soul-sapping miasma that reduces foes' physical and magic defense for a short time.

Those who bore witness to the regal spirits knew that true life extended beyond the reach of the Golden Order.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Stormhawk Reflex
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Inherit a blessing from the storm that surrounds the caster's body with hastening winds, temporarily allowing ease of dodging while boosting stamina regeneration and endurance.

Even with tremendously cumbersome armor, the knights of Stormveil moved and fought with inhuman agility.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Winds of Sovereignty
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Inherit a blessing from the storm that surrounds the caster's body with blockading winds, boosting physical and lightning damage negation.

It was not uncommon to see sparks of lightning shimmering in the castle cyclones, but the mightiest knights armed themselves with the winds alone.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Rampart Barricade
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Inherit a blessing from the storm that surrounds the caster's body with extinguishing winds, boosting physical and fire damage negation.

It was not uncommon to see sparks of lightning shimmering in the castle cyclones, but the mightiest knights armed themselves with the winds alone.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Nightbearer Miracle
caption:
Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Deploys a distortion screen around the caster, increasing non-physical damage negation.
When physically struck by an enemy, the distortion will shift to slowly regenerate the caster's health.

Night Maidens would often employ Sellian sorceries to quickly disengage from danger. Capable assassins, however, saw them fit for exploiting weakness.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Night Maiden's Mist
caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Releases a life-sapping silver mist before the caster, dealing damage to all caught within, including the caster.
This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Below Sellia, the Eternal City of Nokron sleeps. This sorcery originates from the maidens of that place. Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Evernight Snare
caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Lay forth an invisible magic seal directly in front of the caster that ensnares foes that come near, rendering them temporarily vulnerable.

Night Maidens would often employ Sellian sorceries to quickly disengage from danger. Capable assassins, however, saw them fit for exploiting weakness.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Nightbearer Grip
caption:
Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Allows the caster to distort the psyche of the weak-willed, turning a foe to an ally while massively increasing their attack power and damage negation.

To save themselves, Night Maidens would even go as far as obscuring the will of their pursuers, spilling their blood with their own swords.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Fleeting Darkness
caption:
Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Creates a small space of darkness that dispels magic projectiles from foes, using its power to retaliate with night shards.

Originally a lost sorcery of the Eternal City, the despair that brought about its ruin made manifest.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Recusant's Audience
caption:
Sorcery developed from the blasphemy of Rykard's followers.

Bathe the caster's body in blasphemous flame, sacrificing a small portion of HP to alleviate frostbite and hemorrhage buildup.

Rykard's followers once thought his pursuit to be a righteous path, even throwing themselves to the maw of the Serpent King during their audience.
 Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Arciform Comets
caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires four small glintstone projectiles simultaneously that travel in an arc and pursue their target. 

Derivative of a sorcery used by the academy's adjudicator, but some would argue magic evolves quickest when redefined. Boosted by: Lustat Sorcery

name: Crystal Sling
caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Summons a line of large crystals that fire forwards, seeking foes.
Charging increases the amount of crystals summoned.

A sorcery created by the Crystalians that predates almost all of Caria, yet its influence can be seen in numerous magical Carian arts and phalanxes. Boosted by: Crystalian Sorcery

name: Death Rite Repulse
caption:
Ruinous sorcery of the servants of Death.

Produces a concentration of ghostflame at the caster's center and releases it across a wide area, dealing frostbite buildup and cleansing any deathblight from the caster.

The blaze of the lamplight would burn the dead to ash. To the living however, its flame was bitterly, numbingly cold.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Darkstar of the Naturalborn
caption:
Eternal gravity sorcery of Astel, the Naturalborn.

Casts a semi-transparent pulsating darkstar that intermittently shoots gravity projectiles at nearby foes for a brief time.

Crackling and sprawling, the stars fizzle out one by one and form an ocean of emptiness, slowly swallowing the world. Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Cosmic Skyfire
caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Call down a cascade of powerful magic comets from the sky that scour over a wide area in front of the caster.

Carian knights favored magic that enhanced their frontline presence without upstaging their swordsmanship, making this garish sorcery a particular anomaly.
 Boosted by: Crystalian Sorcery

name: Great Storm Spear
caption:
Superior sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Surround the staff with a lightning tempest that lifts the caster upwards, then descend into a downward plunge that sends forth a mighty gale of piercing wind.

This sorcery forms a counterpart to Great Storm Axe. Highly lethal to single targets, but only when cast in the main hand.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Tibia's Cavalry
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Summons three large cavalry knight apparitions to attack foes in front of the caster.

The dead have long been left to wander, lost in lightless obscurity.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Tidal Retaliation
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Calls upon the protection of the ancient priests, manifesting a ring of volatile bubbles that radiate outward from the caster upon taking damage.

The ancient dynasty battled as a single unit with synergy that rivaled a hivemind.
 Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Great Storm Axe
caption:
Superior sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Envelop the staff in a storm tempest, then leap forward to deliver a crashing downward blow that splinters off into highly damaging wind currents.

This sorcery forms a counterpart to Great Storm Spear. Highly lethal to groups of close enemies, but only when cast in the off-hand. Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Helphen's Foresight
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Lends the caster the guidance of the lamplight, allowing them to detect that which would normally be invisible.

Attune yourself to the roots of the lampwood. See the unseen. Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Aberrant Spines
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster with bloodthorns to fling forth an array of sharp splinters that inflict damage and blood loss buildup.

Aberrant sorcerers were not well-versed in traditional magic. Their discovery of the Blood Star yielded sorceries that could instead be cast by inflicting wounds upon oneself.
 Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Simmering Relent
caption:
One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

Widely swing the staff and summon a seething magma comet that launches towards foes.
Can be cast in succession.

After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.
 Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Ancient Tidal Arc
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Fires a crawling wave of water that spreads outward, exploding after traveling a short distance.
Charging generates a bubble shield around the caster that boosts physical damage negation.

Thousands of feet beneath the soil, water-worn structures tell of an ancient dynasty that housed otherworldly intelligence.
 Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Terra Erudita
caption:
Primeval sorcery devised by Azur.

Siphons energies from the primeval current into sorceries, boosting non-physical damage and casting speed.
Magic grows exponentially heavier under the current's weight, allowing closer enemies to be stunned more easily.

Entangled within the primeval current was the one truth. Those closest to the moon felt the current’s pull tenfold.
 Boosted by: Lustat Sorcery

name: Loretta's Protection
caption:
Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Creates a personal barrier that increases magic damage negation while reducing FP consumption (33%). 

Protecting the Carian family would prove a heavy responsibility for entire battalions. Yet this was a task Loretta once proudly fulfilled by herself.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Haligtree Knight's Oath
caption:
Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Creates a magical aura around the caster that wards off elements deemed unworthy by the Carian lineage.
Enormously increases lightning, fire, and holy damage negation while reducing FP consumption (20%).

Loretta, once a royal Carian Knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Splintering Bubble
caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Produces a concentrated bubble that splits into multiple smaller bubbles that drift towards foes.

The claymen search for lost oracles within their bubbles.
 Boosted by: Giantsflame Incantation

name: Haligtree Knight's Mastery
caption:
Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Calls upon the knight Loretta's aid to deliver a barrage of magical arrows cascading downward in a forward area.

The wind stilled and the moon gleamed in the presence of the Haligtree Knight. Her arrival was felt long before it was seen. Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Death Rite Spear
caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Thrust staff into the air and call down a single ritual spear.
Can be followed up with a second spear.

The land of the lampwood was scored by gravestones of unfortunate souls still waiting for death.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Pillars of Magma
caption:
One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

Raise the staff and set it ablaze, then forcefully plunge the staff into the ground, creating a large outward-fanning magma shockwave.

Rykard’s restoring of the ancient hexes led to the discovery that the magma was so ubiquitous on the volcano’s surface, it could be pulled from underneath the very soil. Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Fellstar Crash
caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Thrust the staff upward and call down a massive bolt of gravitational lightning.
Repeated inputs allow for successive casting.

Merely a glimpse of the destructive power fated to end the Eternal City.
 Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Cragflesh
caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Stomp hard into the ground to create a massive gravity well, then reinforce the caster's body with rocks from the earth.
This vastly increases physical damage negation at the expense of mobility.

The Red Lion General wielded gravitational powers which he learned in Selia during his younger days.
All so he would never have to abandon his beloved but scrawny steed. Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Starscourge Hammer
caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Leap forward to create a gravity shockwave and slam staff downward, casting a line of gravity lightning pillars.

The Red Lion General wielded gravitational powers which he learned in Selia during his younger days.
All so he would never have to abandon his beloved but scrawny steed.
 Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Fellstar Rift
caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Calls forth a rift of space that sends a wave of sharp, jagged rocks in front of the caster.

This gravity manipulation was once used by those born of falling stars.
 Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Dark Moon Armament
caption:
Dark moon sorcery of Ranni, the Witch.

Enwreathe armament in the right hand with a cold power synonymous with Ranni's Dark Moon, increasing frostbite buildup and magic damage.

Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden. Within it, a limitless starry expanse of human imperfection.
 Boosted by: Cold Sorcery

name: Torrential Cataclysm
caption:
Primeval sorcery devised by Azur.

Creates a defensive trio of star particles that intermittently launch primeval stars at nearby foes while also protecting the caster from non-physical damage.
The arc and effect will both persist for a short time.

When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw darkness. He was left both bewitched and fearful of the abyss.
 Boosted by: Lustat Sorcery

name: Crystal Shell
caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Enwreathes the caster's body in an unshatterable crystal aura, raising all status resistances and boosting physical damage negation, excluding damage from strikes.

This sorcery is used by high-ranking adepts among the Crystalians. Favored by practitioners of magic who wanted a taste of the frontlines.
 Boosted by: Crystalian Sorcery

name: Aberrant Gouge
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster with bloodthorns to lash forward with a piercing bloodthorn of flame.
Charging increases potency.

Some exiled sorcerers have found a way to transmute the aberrant blood into magic energy, but the true sting of thorns is that of a ruinous, smoldering flame.
 Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Deenh's Stormwind Talons
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Channel the long lost true tempests of stormveil around caster's hands and perform an upwards rending strike with formed hawk talons.

Deenh was a fierce hawk that faithfully rendered lifelong service to the old king of Stormveil long ago, when the true storm raged.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Carian Daggers
caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Conjure a set of fanning magic daggers from the hand and throw them at foes.
The blades seek foes with nigh immaculate precision.

A distinguished sorcery that combines terrifying speed with graceful Carian finesse. Boosted by: Carian Sword Sorcery

name: Meteorite of Radahn
caption:
Unflinching gravity sorcery of Radahn, the Red Lion.

Grips large clumps of rock from the ground and levitates them around the caster, launching themselves at foes after a long delay.
During the delay, this sorcery boosts poise and physical damage negation.

A bulwark of strength against the swirling constellations, Radahn stood in defense of Sellia as both general and student.
 Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Formless Bloodvine Spires
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster multiple times to fire a volley of interlacing thorns that cause heavy damage and blood loss buildup. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up casts.

Scholars turned fanatics, they fed themselves to the star and its awful thorned maw.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Spooling Briar Veins
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Massively wounds the caster with bloodthorns to create thorned entrapments around the area, pulling in foes.
Cast again to release a magic aberrant blast of energy that repels foes back.

Sorcerers who pledged themselves to the Blood Star would indulge in physical depletion, so much so that their very flesh molded to the staves they used. Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Sins of Theodorix
caption:
Blasphemous lava sorcery reminiscent of the ancient hero, Theodorix.

Breathe into staff as if it were a torch and create large pools of magma in a wide area in front of the caster.
Can be cast while on horseback.

Theodorix was once an ancient troll warrior that fought against the giants, but he was cursed for the unforgivable sin of using draconic power.
 Boosted by: Dragon Communion Incantation

name: Surge of Smarag
caption:
Superior glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Breathe into staff as if it were a torch and unleash a volatile wave of glintstone flame in a wide area in front of the caster.

Smarag was a devourer of sorcerers, and over time, his body became corrupted by their glintstones.

name: Miasmic Dust
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestor spirits.

Release a weakening mist fanning outwards from the caster.
The very next melee attack will deal increased damage to any targeted foes.

Those who bore witness to the regal spirits knew that true life extended beyond the reach of the Golden Order.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Matriarch's Promise Hereafter
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancient ancestor spirits.

Invoke the aid of a matronly wraith that pulls in foes while dealing magic damage and steadily restoring the caster's health.
Can be cast while in mid-air.

When the Order arrived, no torches were lit nor weapons drawn. There was only a compliant silence, and the grievous withering that followed it.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Rampart Lance
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Conjure static winds and thrust forward with crackling air, dealing heavy poise damage and knocking back foes. This sorcery can be followed up with an additional attack.

The mighty force of Stormveil's winds were long uncontested.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Crystal Ringblades
caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Flings forward an array of small crystal rings used as throwing instruments by the Crystalians.

Crystal sorceries are among the closest in ideals to the primeval current. As such, the Crystalians are revered guests of the sorcerers.
 Boosted by: Crystalian Sorcery

name: Taker's Spite
caption:
One of the terrible sorceries of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Emit a terrible serpentine roar remindful of the blasphemous lord, then swirl staff around to bathe surroundings with cyclones of magma.

The road of blasphemy is long and perilous. One cannot walk it unprepared to sin.
 Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Sellian Advance
caption:
Superior night sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Blink forward into mist to rapidly close distance, then leap into the air and descend into a wide, horizontal slash.

The most elite assassins of Sellia tempered highly mobile sorceries to quickly withdraw from sight and return to the fray with terrifying lethality.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Rending Talons
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Conjure flaying blades of wind that rupture foes, inflicting gradual damage and blood loss buildup.

The winds whipped with such lethality outside the castle perimeter, travelers unprepared would see their skin shredded from their bones. Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Primordial Stars
caption:
Primeval sorcery devised by Lusat.

Fire forth an ancient shooting star with a nebulous tail.

When Lusat glimpsed into the primeval current, he beheld the final moments of a great star cluster, and upon seeing it, he too was broken.
 Boosted by: Lustat Sorcery

name: Altar of Denial
caption:
Ruinous sorcery of the servants of Death.

Performs a rite in the vicinity that sacrifices a portion of the caster's maximum HP to increase maximum FP & stamina.
Enemies in the radius will have their non-physical attack power greatly lowered.

Wherever the dead gather, the cold flame will soothe the misdirected and signal those who seek the lamplight.
 Boosted by: Death Sorcery

name: Aberrant Blossom
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster to create a blossoming bloodthorn flower that sends ripples of blood through the ground in a wide area for a short time.

Some exiled sorcerers have found a way to transmute the aberrant blood into magic energy, but the true sting of thorns is that of a ruinous, smoldering flame.
 Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Fragmenting Comets
caption:
Primeval sorcery devised by Azur.

Lobs a barrage of explosive starry projectiles that travel in an arc.
Charging concentrates the spell into a single powerful projectile.

When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw only darkness. He was driven into catatonia, pulled into the gateway to a limitless abyss.
 Boosted by: Lustat Sorcery

name: Astel's Waning Darkstar
caption:
Eternal gravity sorcery of Astel, Stars of Darkness.

Dissolve surroundings in a decaying darkstar that implodes after a brief delay, dealing magic damage while pulling foes closer to the caster.

Crackling and sprawling, the stars fizzle out one by one and form an ocean of emptiness, slowly swallowing the world. Boosted by: Gravity Sorcery

name: Nightbearer Curtain
caption:
Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Creates a protective night shield around the caster, softening the next five instances of damage taken.
Enemies in the vicinity will suffer decreased non-physical defense when the shield bursts.

Night Maidens were targets. Passivity was rewarded only with death.
 Boosted by: Night Sorcery

name: Bloodlake
caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals.
Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster with bloodthorns to scatter tainted blood in the vicinity, improving ability to inflict blood loss.
Charging widens the area of effect.

Aberrant sorcerers were not well-versed in traditional magic. Their discovery of the Blood Star yielded sorceries that could instead be cast by inflicting wounds upon oneself.
 Boosted by: Thorn Sorcery

name: Stellar Phantasmic Mirror
caption:
Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Conjure a refracting screen around the caster that redirects magic projectiles and incantations at the expense of reduced physical damage negation.

The phantasms of Sellia cling to a faded reflection of the once-prosperous town. Though painful, one must remember the sorcerous teachings as they were if one hopes to preserve them.

name: Chthonian Chorus
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestor spirits.

Emboldens caster with a sacred tune that boosts magic and holy damage negation, but slightly reduces lightning and fire damage negation.
Increases the efficiency of flasks.

The ancestral followers distanced themselves from the Erdtree in hopes that their horns would one day gleam as bright as the spirits they worshiped.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation

name: Storm the Front!
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Dash forward with haste, leaving behind storm winds that damage foes in the vicinity.
Those at the finishing point of the dash will suffer more damage.

Stormveil’s knights traveled just as they fought, spoke, lived… With haste and recklessness.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Old King's Stance
caption:
Sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Inherit a blessing from the storm that surrounds the caster's body with magic-imbued winds, temporarily making them feel lighter than air.

When Stormveil's old monarch withered away, the true storms followed soon after.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Sweeping Storm Claymore
caption:
Superior sorcery that channels the tempests of Stormveil.

Projects a tempest that fans outward and pulls in foes, then perform a wide sweep with a large greatsword of storm winds.

Those who inherited the blessing of the storm advanced without impediment. Nothing barred their path.
 Boosted by: Bestial Incantation

name: Maw of the Serpent
caption:
One of the terrible sorceries of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Plunge staff into the ground and absorb the energies of those around you, dealing fire damage to foes in the vicinity while boosting fire damage negation.

Rykard's followers once thought his pursuit to be a righteous path, even throwing themselves to the maw of the Serpent King during their audience.
 Boosted by: Magma Sorcery

name: Spiritflesh
caption:
Spectral sorcery of ancestral spirits.

Set caster alight with spectral energy, allowing for a slight amount of HP to be regained when killing foes.

Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.
 Boosted by: Dragon Cult Incantation
